notificationsHelp: Enable reminders on this device, then choose a reminder time for each habit.
notificationsOfflineHint: Background reminders need internet. Habit edits and checkoffs work offline, but unsynced changes cannot cancel a reminder already queued. Delayed reminders expire at the end of the habit’s local day.
reminderTimeHint: Time follows {{timezone}} and any future timezone changes. Longer-period habits remind daily until completed.
reminderDeviceHint: Enable notifications in Settings on each device where you want reminders. Changes apply after synchronization.
NOTIFICATIONS_IOS_INSTALL: On iPhone and iPad (iOS 16.4 or later), add Machbar to your Home Screen and open it there to enable notifications.
NOTIFICATIONS_UNSUPPORTED: This browser does not support background push notifications.
NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE: Notifications are unavailable. Ask your server administrator to enable them.
NOTIFICATIONS_BLOCKED: Notifications were not allowed. If blocked, change permission in your browser or device notification settings.
NOTIFICATIONS_DISABLED: Enable notifications on this device first.
NOTIFICATION_WORKER_NOT_READY: Install any available Machbar update, then reopen the app to enable notifications.
NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_FAILED: The notification could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
NOTIFICATION_DEVICE_LIMIT: This profile has reached its notification device limit.
PUSH_DATA_CORRUPT: Notification data could not be read. Ask the server administrator to check the saved push state.
todaySubtitle: Your next small win is right here.
allDone: Look at you go. All done!
keepGoing: One small step at a time.
noDueSteps: No goal steps scheduled for this day.
standaloneGoal: Complete this goal in one step
GOAL_HAS_STEPS: Complete this goal by finishing its steps.
optionalStepsHelp: Undated goals and steps don’t affect your daily progress. Each win still earns XP.
noHabits: Make room for a small win

emptyGoalsDescription: Give your goal a name, then break it into steps you can actually do.

noNextGift: Give your progress a little extra meaning.
plantDescription: Level {{level}} plant with {{leaves}} leaves and {{petals}} blossom petals
streakExplanation: Consecutive scheduled days or periods count. The current period stays open until it ends.

goalTitle: e.g. Make my home feel like home
giftTitle: e.g. A new pair of shoes
newGoal: A goal worth taking small steps for
intervalAnchorHint: Weeks start Monday; months start on the 1st. Complete once anytime in each period.
periodHabitsHint: Complete once before the period ends. These habits don’t add to your daily target.
intervalChangeHint: A new rhythm starts a new current streak. Your best streak and past wins stay saved.
selectUserHelp: Enter an existing user ID or scan its QR code to open your profile.
USER_CREATION_DISABLED: New profiles are disabled. Use an existing profile to continue.
DOCUMENT_LIMIT: This profile has reached its size limit. Remove unused items before syncing.
PROFILE_LIMIT: This server has reached its profile limit. Contact its administrator.
STORAGE_LIMIT: This server has reached its storage limit. Contact its administrator.
SERVER_BUSY: The server is busy. Synchronization will retry shortly.
noSteps: Start by adding one small step.
countTarget: I complete a habit a number of times
giftStreak: {{count}} scheduled days in a row with {{name}}
goalsSubtitle: Make the big things feel doable.
habitsSubtitle: Build a little consistency, one day at a time.
name: What should we call you?
timezoneHint: Your days follow this timezone. Changes apply to future habit occurrences.
avatarPreviewHint: A little face, all your own.
avatarEditHint: Choose your look. Your preview updates as you go.
avatarDraftHint: Choose your look, then finish your profile to save it.
preferencesSaved: All set. Your preferences are saved.
browserProfile: Your browser has its own profile. Use your user ID to share it across devices.
userIdentitySubtitle: Keep your progress with you across browsers and devices.
userIdHelp: Save this ID or QR code to open your profile on another device.
userIdQr: QR code for your user ID
idCopied: Your user ID has been copied.
copyIdManually: Your ID is selected. Copy it using your browser’s copy command.
userIdPrivacy: Keep your ID private. Anyone with it can access and change your progress.
switchUserHelp: Enter an existing ID or scan its QR code, then switch to that profile. Your current profile stays saved.
qrScanned: User ID found. Choose Switch profile to use it.
switchPending: Sync or discard pending changes before switching profiles.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
USER_NOT_FOUND: No saved profile has this user ID. Check the ID and try again.
QR_NOT_FOUND: No QR code was found in this image.
QR_ERROR: Could not read or create the QR image. Try another image or enter the ID.
CAMERA_UNAVAILABLE: Could not open the camera. Allow camera access or upload a QR image.
installHelp: On iPhone or iPad, use Share → Add to Home Screen. On other browsers, look for the install option in the browser menu.
offline: You’re offline. All changes are saved on this device.
syncLogHelp: The last 50 sync attempts for this profile on this device, newest first.
STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: The saved data on this device is temporarily unavailable. Close other Machbar windows and try again. Your saved data has been kept.
conflict: Some saved offline changes could not be recovered. Your local data is retained. Use server progress to discard pending changes.
discardConfirm: Discard all pending local changes and reload saved data?
updateReady: A fresh version of Machbar is ready.
updatePending: Sync your pending changes before updating.

historyHelp: Missed a checkoff? Use the day arrows to log your recent habits.

littleNote: Progress doesn’t have to be perfect to count.
giftCelebration: You earned this. Enjoy your gift!
